class.name: NetwPredictCommandFrame
class.brief_description: One owner-to-authority command window: a contiguous transition run, its schema-planned payload rows, and the evidence fingerprints proving its closed prefix.
class.description: A frame is built one direction and read the other, and both directions share this one class rather than a pair of hand-written codecs. A sender calls [method create], appends rows in order, and asks for [method to_bytes]. A receiver calls [method from_bytes] and reads the same columns back through the same accessors. [codeblock] var frame := NetwPredictCommandFrame.create(schema) frame.set_epoch(epoch) frame.set_ack_of_acks(ack_of_acks) for index in range(oldest, newest + 1): if not frame.append_transition(index, label, fresh): break if fresh: frame.append_payload(values) send(frame.to_bytes()) [/codeblock] [member SchemaRecord] is fixed at construction, because a payload row is only meaningful beside the plan it was gathered under, and a frame that could be re-planned mid-fill would hold rows of two shapes. [method create] and [method from_bytes] both return [code]null[/code] rather than a half-built frame when the schema will not compile or the bytes will not decode. [br][br][method append_transition] enforces one contiguous run: a gap would leave the base index and the row count disagreeing about which transition a later row names. [method append_payload] is called only for a fresh transition, so [method payload_count] tracks the fresh subset of [method transition_count] rather than matching it row for row. [method append_evidence] is called only for the closed prefix the owner can already speak for, so [method evidence_count] is the leading run of [method indices] the owner has finished, and a still open row simply stops that run rather than appearing as a zero claim.

method.name: ack_of_acks
method.description: The newest ack this frame's owner has itself acknowledged, set by [method set_ack_of_acks]. Lets authority retire its own ack history once the owner confirms it arrived, rather than resending it forever.

method.name: append_evidence
method.description: Appends one evidence row for the next transition in the closed prefix this frame is proving. [param pre_family_fps] and [param post_family_fps] must each hold exactly the pose, momentum, and controller triple, in that order, or this returns [code]false[/code] and appends nothing. Evidence rows are positional against the leading run of [method indices]; there is no explicit transition index per evidence row.

method.name: append_payload
method.description: Appends one payload row, encoded against this frame's [SchemaRecord], for the fresh transition most recently passed to [method append_transition]. Returns [code]false[/code] without appending when [param values] does not match the schema's declared shape.

method.name: append_transition
method.description: Appends one transition to the window. Returns [code]false[/code] and appends nothing when the window has already reached its wire cap, or when [param index] does not immediately follow the previous append, since the window is a single contiguous run. Pass [param fresh] [code]true[/code] only for a transition this frame also owes a [method append_payload] call.

method.name: create
method.description: Builds an empty frame planned against [param schema], or [code]null[/code] when the schema will not compile to a wire plan.

method.name: e_digests
method.description: One environment digest per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: epoch
method.description: This frame's epoch byte, set by [method set_epoch]. A receiver reads it to tell a frame from a stream that restarted from one that continues an existing one.

method.name: evidence_count
method.description: How many evidence rows this frame carries, the bound for every [code]*_fps[/code] and [code]evidence_masks[/code] accessor. At most [method transition_count], since evidence never outruns the transitions it proves.

method.name: evidence_masks
method.description: One evidence-kind bitmask per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: fresh_flags
method.description: One byte per transition, [code]1[/code] where [method append_transition] was called with [param fresh] [code]true[/code] and [code]0[/code] otherwise, in [method indices] order.

method.name: from_bytes
method.description: Decodes [param bytes] as a frame planned against [param schema], or [code]null[/code] when the schema will not compile or the bytes do not decode against it.

method.name: indices
method.description: The transition indices this frame's window covers, one contiguous ascending run, in [method append_transition] order.

method.name: labels
method.description: One command label per transition, in [method indices] order.

method.name: payload_at
method.description: Decodes the payload row at [param index] against this frame's [SchemaRecord], or an empty [Array] when [param index] is outside [code][0, payload_count)[/code].

method.name: payload_count
method.description: How many payload rows this frame carries, the bound for [param index] on [method payload_at]. Counts only the fresh transitions [method append_payload] was called for, so it is at most and usually less than [method transition_count].

method.name: post_family_fps
method.description: The post-state pose, momentum, and controller fingerprints, flattened three per evidence row in that order, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: post_fps
method.description: One combined post-state fingerprint per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: pre_family_fps
method.description: The pre-state pose, momentum, and controller fingerprints, flattened three per evidence row in that order, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: pre_fps
method.description: One combined pre-state fingerprint per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: raw_fps
method.description: One unclassified raw fingerprint per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: set_ack_of_acks
method.description: Sets [method ack_of_acks] to [param transition].

method.name: set_epoch
method.description: Sets [method epoch] to [param epoch], truncated to the low 8 bits.

method.name: to_bytes
method.description: Encodes this frame's transitions, payload rows, and evidence against its [SchemaRecord]'s wire plan, the bytes [method from_bytes] decodes back.

method.name: topo_fps
method.description: One topology fingerprint per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.

method.name: transition_count
method.description: How many transitions this frame's window carries, the bound for [method indices], [method labels], and [method fresh_flags]. Capped at the wire's maximum window length; [method append_transition] refuses to extend it further.

method.name: witness_fps
method.description: One witness fingerprint per evidence row, in [method append_evidence] order.
